"# Walkthrough — Operation Close Win (Bomb Refinement & Restart Seed Controls)

All items from your latest request have been implemented, tested, and verified.

## 1. Summary of Changes

### 💣 1. Bomb Countdown Refinement (Board Moves Only)
- **Problem:** Previously, drawing a card from the deck (`drawCard`) also counted towards ticking down the bomb timer.
- **Fix:**
  - Removed bomb timer decrementing from `drawCard()` in [`TripeaksEngine.ts`](file:///c:/Misc/GuapikoProjects/Vaults/GuapikoClaw/GuapikoClaw/Projects/SoftGames/softgames-closewin/src/core/TripeaksEngine.ts).

---

### 🎲 2. Seed Randomization on Restart & "Keep Seed" Checkbox
- **Restart Behavior:**
  - Clicking **↺ Restart** now generates a fresh random PRNG seed (`Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000) + 1`), providing a new card deal and shuffle every time.
- **"Keep Seed" Toggle:**
  - Added a **`☑ Keep seed`** checkbox next to the Restart button in the game toolbar.
  - When checked, clicking **↺ Restart** retains the current seed, allowing the player to replay the exact same board deal to test alternative move sequences.
